item.title: User and Group Management in Linux
item.description:
Objective

Learn how to creat users and manage perissions, which is crucial for server security.

Practice Process

I executed the following commands:

  • sudo adduser student01
  • sudo groupadd engineering
  • sudo usermod -aG engineering student01

Understanding user groups is very helpful,especially when setting up web servers for future engineering projectd.
